I just got done seeing Creed. I mean, I'm literally out in the AMC parking lot as I'm typing this. My first critique is the pacing. You hardly have any time to digest what's going on before you get to the next scene. This may just be a personal preference, but i think it should've had a slower burn to it, since this is partially a drama flick. Now, this being a Rocky spin-off, it does well to staying true to the original films. That being said, it does a little TOO much to stay loyal. On one hand, it's its own story, but on the other, it's basically a retelling of Rocky. If you take the premise of it, that's fine, but Creed is basically "Black Rocky." That's a tad of an exaggeration, but you see my point. That said, Michael B. Jordan does an excellent job playing the part of Apollo's boy. I do like how he tries to make a name for himself, and he considers himself his own man. That's good, I didn't want to see a carbon copy of Apollo. That's rarely how things are in real life. One other thing it did is get me pumped for a sequel. This was basically Adonis's origin story. Hopefully, next time, if there is one, his character will be more developed. Let's talk about Rocky, tho.

Stallone always seems to phase back into the role of Rocky Balboa seamlessly, and Rocky's role transitioning from fighter to mentor was handled very well too. Him and "Donny" (Adonis's nickname throughout the film) see to have tremendous chemistry together. If there is a sequel, i look forward to his death scene, and how Donny copes with it. Obviously this is a long shot since "Rocky" is one of the most profitable names ever, but what would you rather have; eating rotten steak that's had mold growing on it for at least 20 years, or have new, fresh meat to cook amd male into something delicious? I have plenty more to say, but I'm freezing my fingers off, so, bottom line, 7.5/10. What do you guys think?
